name: cx-box
task: Carry the box to the exit, and whenever the box falls, pick it up again.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Existence(at_exit) and Response(at_exit, holding_box) capture carrying the box to the exit, and Response(box_fell, holding_box) requires picking it up again after every fall.

texts: The box must be held at the exit.
If the agent reaches the exit, the box must be held.
Whenever the box falls, it must be picked up again at some later step.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2, u3, u4
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES: u3
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&!holding_box) -> u2
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u1, !at_exit&holding_box) -> u0
(u1, at_exit&!holding_box) -> u4
(u1, at_exit&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u2, box_fell&!holding_box) -> u4
(u2, box_fell&holding_box) -> u3
(u4, holding_box) -> u3
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box, u1) -> -1
(u0, at_exit&!box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&!holding_box, u4) -> -1
(u0, at_exit&box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u1, !at_exit&holding_box, u0) -> 1
(u1, at_exit&holding_box, u3) -> 12
(u2, !box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u2, box_fell&!holding_box, u4) -> -1
(u2, box_fell&holding_box, u3) -> 11
(u4, holding_box, u3) -> 12
